args.body: Hello, thanks for reporting this. Sorry, our system wrongly logged it as a fridge issue; we have corrected it to a front door repair and treat it as urgent. Please ignore the fridge questions. For now, please close the door gently rather than slamming it, as slamming could crack the glass. If any glass is cracked, keep clear of it and tell us straight away. Two quick questions: does the front door lock and stay secure when closed, so the flat is safe tonight? And is the glass in the door cracked or damaged at all? Also, please tell us of any access details or pets we should know about. We are asking your landlord to approve the repair and will update you by tomorrow.
